title: changes.since result
description: File and node deltas between since and the envelope snapshot, filtered to scope. history says whether the service could compute them.

history.description: known: deltas below are complete for scope. unknown: since is not related to this snapshot by captured history. expired: since was evicted; deltas are empty.

relevant.description: True when anything in scope changed (with scope.candidate: anything the candidate read or wrote).
